'''James Lewis'''<ref name="dt-19371">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19371 The Beast (QMC) No R3], DeckTech (James "Gold Chocobo" Lewis, 16 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19371/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19371/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Gold Chocobo''') posted a [[Light]] [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]] list on DeckTech in October 2001. On the Players Committee forum he posted as Captain_Twinkie.<ref name="sf-20910-315597">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=315597#p315597 Idaho States?], James Lewis (Captain_Twinkie), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (16 July 2008).</ref> For the [[2008 Idaho State Championship]] he was to collect the $10 entry fees and bring the prize support.<ref name="sf-20910-323190">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=323190#p323190 Idaho States?], Scott Church (CategoryOneGames.com), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125184349/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20910-start140.html Internet Archive]</ref> His forum signature (as shown on the live forum) lists 5th place at the 2009 Utah State Championship and 6th at the 2009 Idaho State Championship.<ref name="sf-20910-315597" />
